## Problem

What is incorrect in the current documentation or repository? Planned functionality is not yet implemented.

## Location and reproduction

Include the file or commit, relevant steps, and environment if applicable.

## Expected and actual result

Explain the difference. Include a redacted example if useful.

## Evidence and checks

Link to publishable supporting sources and describe what you checked. Do not attach prospect lists, private client information, credentials, or personal contact data.
